svg.title: Two strip plots of 784 poles in four models. Under the record's line the medians are 23.1% for Pythia-70m, 11.1% for GPT-2, 1.6% for Qwen2.5-0.5B, 0.7% for Qwen2.5-1.5B. Under the conformal line every model's median is about 5%.
svg.text: The fixed line fires on 0.7% to 23% of corpus windows, and the conformal line on about 5%
The share of 1,000 held-out 20-token corpus windows on which each VERIFIED pole
fires. Left: the record's own line, 0.25 × its maximum. Right: the split-conformal
line at α = 0.05. One dot per pole; the ink line and value are each model's median.
